 Smilegate to Showcase 'MIRESI' at Japan's Comic Market in December
 Soojin "Eonn" Kim 
 eonn@inven.co.kr 
 Nov 8, 2026 
 Korean (한국어) 
 KO 
 Add us on 
 ⓒ Smilegate Smilegate announced on November 9 that it will showcase MIRESI: Invisible Future at Comic Market (Comiket 109), held at Tokyo Big Sight in Japan for three days from December 29 to 31.
 The MIRESI booth will be located in West Exhibition Hall 4 at Tokyo Big Sight. Smilegate plans to expand opportunities to engage with local subculture fans while maintaining momentum with global fans. Details regarding booth operations and events will be released sequentially on the official X channel.
 MIRESI is a new title created with the participation of Art Director Hyung-sub Kim (Hyulla), featuring a time-themed worldview and real-time turn-based combat. Previously at Tokyo Game Show 2026 in September, the developer showcased content allowing players to customize characters photographed during battle into figures. Smilegate shared that this content received an enthusiastic response from local visitors.
 Smilegate is currently conducting pre-registrations for MIRESI. Information about the game can be found on its official YouTube and official community X channel.
 Originally written in Korean, this article was translated with AI assistance and edited by a native English-speaking editor. Every translation is reviewed by our editorial team before publication.
